description_html:
Product Overview

This listing features a highly reliable benthic-range pressure calibrator, distinguished by its superior accuracy class of 0.75 percent. Engineered for demanding environments, it is designed to perform flawlessly at operating temperatures as low as -40 degrees Celsius. With an impressive sampling rate of 1316.6 hertz, this calibrator ensures rapid and precise data acquisition—an essential attribute for rigorous underwater pressure measurement applications.

Technical Specifications

  • Accuracy Class: 0.75%
  • Operating Temperature: Down to -40°C
  • Sampling Rate: 1316.6 Hz
  • Calibration Interval: 25 months
  • Mounting: Tripod
  • Pricing: Unit price determined upon acceptance

Key Features

Each specification has been meticulously measured and documented according to the same six axes used to evaluate all products within this category. This standardization guarantees direct comparability and underscores the calibrator’s compliance with industry-leading benchmarks.

Why Choose This Calibrator?

With its exceptional accuracy, robust operational range, and extended calibration interval, this benthic-range pressure calibrator stands out as the definitive choice for professionals seeking uncompromising quality and reliability in subsea pressure measurement. When you demand confidence in your instrumentation, this calibrator delivers.
